introHtml: Custom 3 oz dispensary containers are ideal for portion-controlled packaging of samples, single-use servings, or trial-sized products. This compact size is a favorite among dispensaries and CPG brands for giving customers a low-commitment way to try new offerings. With a 3 oz capacity, these containers are also well-suited for on-the-go use, fitting easily into pockets or small bags. Decorate them with your logo using screen printing or labels for a professional look that encourages repeat purchases.
